.vector{display:inline-block;width:1em;height:1em;vertical-align:middle;fill:none;overflow:visible;flex-shrink:0}
.hero-metric .symbol{color:#ff8e8d}.hero-metric .symbol .vector{width:7cqw;height:7cqw;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 .7cqw #ff3cbb)}
.hero-metric .flag{color:#fff}.hero-metric .flag .vector{width:5.5cqw;height:5.5cqw;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 .6cqw #f76aff)}
.metric .gauge{height:4.8cqw}.metric .gauge .vector{width:5.3cqw;height:5.3cqw;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 .6cqw #e52dff)}
.metric:nth-child(2) .gauge{color:#ff7898}.metric:nth-child(4) .gauge{color:#ff849a}
.second .emoji .vector{width:5.8cqw;height:5.8cqw;color:#ff52b9;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 .8cqw #e82aff)}
.route-title-icon{width:5.2cqw;height:5.2cqw;color:#fa4bb8;margin-right:1cqw;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 .8cqw #f53ad0)}
.segment-icon{width:3.7cqw;height:3.7cqw;color:var(--c);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 .7cqw var(--c))}
.summary-icon{width:5.2cqw;height:5.2cqw;color:#f7d0ff;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 .7cqw #ff48d7)}
.share .vector{width:4cqw;height:4cqw}
.sheet{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 72% 14%,#8e058e 0,transparent 32%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 6% 57%,#46045b 0,transparent 42%),linear-gradient(120deg,#1c032e,#11041e 67%,#310039)}
.box{background:linear-gradient(113deg,#51105d 0%,#230c36 49%,#49115e 100%);border-color:#f75dfa;box-shadow:0 0 1.1cqw #fb43f5bb,inset 0 0 1.4cqw #ee50ef48,0 0 .4cqw #ffc1ff}
.metric{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#532064 0%,#241034 85%);box-shadow:inset 0 0 1.5cqw #d862ff32,0 0 .6cqw #b53ac94d}
.hero-metric{box-shadow:0 0 1.7cqw #ff50e5,inset 0 0 2cqw #ff55c633;border-color:#ffb2fa}
.route{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4b145b,#1c0a34 60%,#4b1559);box-shadow:0 0 2cqw #ff3fea,inset 0 0 2.2cqw #fc56d93a;border-color:#ff92ff}
.route .chart{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 .8cqw #f53ef4)}
.segment{background:linear-gradient(130deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 26%,#27103a),#180c2e);box-shadow:0 0 1.1cqw var(--c),inset 0 0 1cqw color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 25%,transparent)}
.summary{box-shadow:0 0 1.7cqw #f84be3,inset 0 0 1.5cqw #ff4fdd36}
.medal{background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 24%,#fff6b4 0%,#ffd55c 35%,#e99d1b 77%,#a35a06);border-color:#ffe78e;box-shadow:0 0 1.5cqw #ffbe38,0 0 2.8cqw #d54bbf,inset 0 0 .8cqw #fff9b4}
.medal:before{content:'❧';position:absolute;left:7%;top:34%;font-size:5cqw;color:#a46c14;transform:rotate(-55deg)}
.route .segments{position:relative;z-index:1}

/* V1.4 — Percurso virtual: cards contidos, proporções e acabamento */
.route{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;overflow:hidden;padding:1.9cqw 2.2cqw 2.1cqw!important}
.route-head{flex:0 0 auto;min-height:5.6cqw;align-items:center}
.route .chart{display:block;flex:0 0 auto;width:100%;height:10.8cqw!important;margin:1.1cqw 0 .8cqw!important;overflow:visible;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 .65cqw #f53ef4)}
.route .segments{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1.45cqw;height:auto!important;flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;align-items:stretch;padding:.45cqw .35cqw .35cqw;overflow:visible}
.route .segment{min-width:0;min-height:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:.1cqw;padding:.45cqw .3cqw!important;border-radius:1.8cqw;line-height:1.08;font-size:2.05cqw;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 0 .85cqw var(--c),inset 0 0 1.1cqw color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 24%,transparent)}
.route .segment b{font-size:2.55cqw;margin:.1cqw 0!important}
.route .segment small{font-size:1.95cqw}
.route .segment-icon{width:3.15cqw;height:3.15cqw;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 .55cqw var(--c))}
.route:after{content:'';position:absolute;pointer-events:none;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;box-shadow:inset 0 0 1.8cqw #f449f76a}
/* V1.7 — ajuste isolado: ícone de distância sem corte */
.hero-metric .symbol{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 8cqw;min-width:0;overflow:visible}
.hero-metric .symbol .vector{display:block;width:6.3cqw!important;height:6.3cqw!important;max-width:100%;flex-shrink:0;overflow:visible;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 .45cqw #ff63b4)}

/* V2.2 — seletor compacto, sem cards; arte aprovada preservada */
.compact-model-picker{box-sizing:border-box;max-width:864px;margin:0 auto;padding:12px 18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:#24072f;color:#fff;font:700 14px Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif}
.compact-model-picker label{white-space:nowrap}
.compact-model-picker select{appearance:auto;min-width:0;width:min(230px,65vw);padding:10px 12px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid #d65ad4;background:#37134b;color:#fff;font:600 14px Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
.compact-model-picker select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ff8cda;outline-offset:2px}
</style><style>/* V1.5: somente ícone e degradê da distância equivalente */
.hero-metric .symbol .vector{width:8.2cqw;height:8.2cqw;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 .65cqw #ff63b4)}
.hero-metric .big{background:linear-gradient(110deg,#ffb2e6 0%,#ff72c7 32%,#f54cae 65%,#e98be9 100%);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;filter:drop-shadow(0 .2cqw .18cqw #9c175f88)}
.hero-metric .big small{font-weight:900}
</style><style>/* V1.6 — única alteração: composição interna dos quatro sub-blocos do percurso */
.route .segments{gap:1.25cqw!important;padding:.35cqw .25cqw .6cqw!important;align-items:stretch!important;overflow:hidden!important}
.route .segment{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:4.4cqw minmax(0,1fr)!important;grid-template-rows:1fr!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:stretch!important;gap:.35cqw!important;padding:.55cqw .35cqw!important;text-align:left!important;white-space:normal!important;overflow:hidden!important;border-radius:1.9cqw!important;min-height:0!important;line-height:1.03!important}
.route .segment .segment-icon{grid-column:1;display:block!important;width:3.9cqw!important;height:4.4cqw!important;margin:0!important;align-self:center;justify-self:center;flex:none!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 .55cqw var(--c))}
.route .segment .segment-content{grid-column:2;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;gap:.22cqw;line-height:1.06}
.route .segment .segment-name{font-size:1.95cqw;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}
.route .segment .segment-content b{display:block;font-size:2.45cqw!important;line-height:1.06;margin:0!important;white-space:nowrap}
.route .segment .segment-content small{display:block;font-size:1.85cqw!important;line-height:1.08;white-space:nowrap}
</style><style>/* V1.8: somente medalha premium sobre a foto */
.medal.at{background:none!important;border:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;border-radius:0!important;display:block!important;transform:none!important;overflow:visible!important;top:21.5%!important;right:3.3%!important;width:21%!important;aspect-ratio:auto!important;height:15%!important;z-index:5!important}
.medal.at::after{content:none!important;display:none!important}
.medal-art{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible;filter:drop-shadow(0 .45cqw .5cqw #330c19) drop-shadow(0 0 1.1cqw #ffb92f99)}
</style><style>/* V1.10: medalha fiel à opção 3 aprovada, sem redesenho. Demais elementos preservados. */
.medal.at .medal-art{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;object-fit:contain!important;object-position:center top!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 .45cqw #ffb23f88)!important}
/* V1.11: amplia a medalha e exibe a fita rosa inteira, sem afetar os outros blocos. */
.medal.at{top:19.4%!important;right:1.8%!important;width:24.5%!important;height:auto!important;aspect-ratio:auto!important;overflow:visible!important}
.medal.at .medal-art{display:block!important;width:100%!important;height:auto!important;max-height:none!important;object-fit:contain!important;object-position:center center!important}
</style><style>/* V1.12: fita restaurada na imagem, preservando o restante */ .medal.at{width:25.5%!important;right:1.3%!important}</style><style>/* V1.15 — somente a medalha: arte original enviada, menor e afastada do rosto */
.medal.at{width:19.2%!important;right:3.0%!important;top:21.8%!important;height:auto!important;aspect-ratio:auto!important;overflow:visible!important;transform:none!important;}
.medal.at .medal-art{display:block!important;width:100%!important;height:auto!important;max-height:none!important;object-fit:contain!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 .3cqw .65cqw #20062499)!important;}
</style><style>
/* V2: apenas textos e tipografia, sem alterações na arte V1.15 */
.model-controls{max-width:864px;margin:0 auto;padding:15px 12px;background:#1c082d;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;font-family:Arial,sans-serif}
.model-controls strong{margin-right:8px;font-size:14px;color:#ffb8eb}.model-controls button{border:1px solid #ad51c7;background:#3c174f;color:white;border-radius:24px;padding:10px 13px;font-size:13px;font-weight:bold;cursor:pointer}.model-controls button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#ec2da6;border-color:#ffa1dc;box-shadow:0 0 12px #ee32ae77}
.sheet[data-model="superacao"] .hero-title{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;letter-spacing:-.065em;font-style:italic;font-size:7.5cqw}
.sheet[data-model="evolucao"] .hero-title{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;font-style:normal;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-.07em}
.sheet[data-model="missao"] .hero-title{font-family:Impact,'Arial Narrow',Arial,sans-serif;font-style:italic;letter-spacing:-.025em;font-size:7.4cqw}
.sheet[data-model="energia"] .hero-title{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-style:italic;letter-spacing:-.075em;font-size:7.3cqw}
.sheet[data-model="superacao"] .quote,.sheet[data-model="energia"] .quote{font-style:italic}
.sheet[data-model="missao"] .quote{font-weight:700}
</style><style>
/* V2.3: só tipografia dos títulos e paleta de destaque, sem mover os blocos aprovados. */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:ital,wght@0,800;0,900;1,800;1,900&family=Permanent+Marker&family=Kaushan+Script&display=swap');
.sheet{--accent:#ff55b5;--accent-light:#ffb9e8}
.sheet[data-color="lilas"]{--accent:#b88aff;--accent-light:#e5d3ff}
.sheet[data-color="azul"]{--accent:#45b9ff;--accent-light:#c9edff}
.sheet[data-color="turquesa"]{--accent:#32dfcb;--accent-light:#c3fff5}
.sheet[data-color="laranja"]{--accent:#ffad49;--accent-light:#ffe0ac}
.sheet .hero-title .pink{color:var(--accent)!important}
.sheet[data-model="superacao"] .hero-title,
.sheet[data-model="missao"] .hero-title{font-family:'Permanent Marker','Barlow Condensed',Impact,sans-serif!important;font-weight:900!important;font-style:normal!important;font-size:6.75cqw!important;letter-spacing:-.025em!important;line-height:.99!important;transform:skew(-4deg);transform-origin:left center;text-shadow:1px 2px 2px #15071a,0 0 .35cqw #ffffff20}
.sheet[data-model="evolucao"] .hero-title{font-family:'Barlow Condensed',Impact,sans-serif!important;font-size:7.7cqw!important;font-weight:900!important;font-style:italic!important;letter-spacing:-.025em!important;line-height:.94!important}
.sheet[data-model="original"] .hero-title{font-family:Arial,'Liberation Sans',Helvetica,sans-serif!important;font-size:6.8cqw!important;font-weight:900!important;font-style:italic!important;letter-spacing:-.067em!important;line-height:.93!important;transform:skew(-5deg);transform-origin:left center;text-shadow:0 2px 4px #17051c}
.sheet[data-model="energia"] .hero-title{font-family:'Barlow Condensed',Impact,sans-serif!important;font-size:7.1cqw!important;font-weight:900!important;font-style:italic!important;letter-spacing:-.03em!important}
.sheet[data-model="superacao"] .quote,.sheet[data-model="energia"] .quote{font-style:normal!important}
.compact-model-picker{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 12px}
.compact-model-picker select{width:auto;max-width:44vw;flex:1 1 125px}
.compact-model-picker .color-label{margin-left:auto}
@media(max-width:440px){.compact-model-picker{padding:10px}.compact-model-picker select{max-width:34vw;padding:8px 5px;font-size:12px}.compact-model-picker label{font-size:12px}}
<style>/* V2.5: ajuste isolado do modelo Superação, inspirado na caligrafia inclinada da referência. */
.sheet[data-model="superacao"] .hero-title{
  font-family:'Kaushan Script','Segoe Print','Brush Script MT',cursive!important;
  font-size:6.65cqw!important;
  font-weight:400!important;
  font-style:normal!important;
  letter-spacing:-.045em!important;
  line-height:1.04!important;
  transform:rotate(-5deg) skew(-3deg)!important;
  transform-origin:left center!important;
  text-shadow:0 .18cqw .2cqw #16031e,0 0 .22cqw #ffffff26!important;
}
.sheet[data-model="superacao"] .hero-title .pink{color:var(--accent)!important}
</style></style><style>
/* V2.7: cinco fontes incorporadas e seleção independente */
@font-face{font-family:"Bike Esportiva";src:url("data:font/ttf;base64,") format("truetype");font-display:block;}
@font-face{font-family:"Bike Caligrafia";src:url("data:font/otf;base64,
